allOf.description: Describes the Egeria governance action (engine action) that a run represents.

iscQualifiedName.description: Qualified name of the information supply chain that the governance action is part of.

engineActionGUID.description: Unique identifier of the engine action that describes this run.

governanceEngineName.description: Name of the governance engine that ran the governance action.

requestType.description: Request type that selected the governance service.

governanceActionTypeName.description: Name of the governance action type that the engine action was created from.

processName.description: Name of the governance action process that the engine action is part of.

processStepName.description: Name of the governance action process step that the engine action implements.
